formats.key: swap(address caller, (address srcToken, address dstToken, address srcReceiver, address dstReceiver, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturnAmount, uint256 flags, bytes permit) desc, bytes data)
effects: The signer sends desc.amount of desc.srcToken to desc.srcReceiver (ERC-20 via transferFrom), or desc.amount of ETH when srcToken is 0x0 or 0xEeee.
With flag _REQUIRES_EXTRA_ETH the signer sends more ETH than desc.amount (any msg.value > amount, or > 0 for an ERC-20 source), and the router forwards all of it to the executor `caller`.
When desc.permit is not empty, the router submits an ERC-2612 or DAI permit on srcToken in the signer's name, which sets an allowance.
The router sends its whole dstToken balance to desc.dstReceiver, or to the signer when dstReceiver is the zero address.
Without _PARTIAL_FILL, the signer's output is at least desc.minReturnAmount of dstToken.
With _PARTIAL_FILL, the router returns the unspent srcToken to the signer and only checks the rate returnAmount/spent >= minReturnAmount/amount, so the output can be below minReturnAmount.
formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send (srcToken), Minimum to Receive (dstToken) and Beneficiary (dstReceiver); executor, srcReceiver, flags, permit, data and the native value are hidden.

findings.title: swap hides msg.value; with the extra-ETH flag the signer sends more ETH than the amount shown.
findings.evidence: AggregationRouterV4.sol swap: `if (flags & _REQUIRES_EXTRA_ETH != 0) { require(msg.value > (srcETH ? desc.amount : 0), ...)` and `address(caller).call{value: msg.value}(callData)`. Descriptor swap format has no `@.value` field; `desc.flags` is `visible: never`.
findings.fix: Add a field `{"path": "@.value", "label": "ETH sent", "format": "amount"}` with visible always.

findings.title: swap shows 'Minimum to Receive', but with the partial-fill flag the signer can receive less.
findings.evidence: AggregationRouterV4.sol swap: `if (flags & _PARTIAL_FILL != 0) { ... srcToken.uniTransfer(msg.sender, unspentAmount); require(returnAmount.mul(desc.amount) >= desc.minReturnAmount.mul(spentAmount), ...)`. Descriptor: `desc.minReturnAmount` label 'Minimum to Receive'; `desc.flags` visible never.
findings.fix: Show `desc.flags` bit 0 as a 'Partial fill allowed' field, or change the label to 'Minimum rate (full amount)' and say that unspent input returns to the signer.

findings.title: swap hides desc.permit, which sets an allowance on the source token in the signer's name.
findings.evidence: swap: `_permit(address(srcToken), desc.permit);` → Permitable._permit calls `token.call(abi.encodePacked(IERC20Permit.permit.selector, permit))`. Descriptor: `desc.permit` 'Desc Permit' visible never.
findings.fix: Add a field that states a permit runs when desc.permit is not empty, or show the spender and value slices of desc.permit.

findings.title: swap shows a zero dstReceiver as the zero address, but the code then pays the signer.
findings.evidence: swap: `address payable dstReceiver = (desc.dstReceiver == address(0)) ? msg.sender : desc.dstReceiver;`. Descriptor field `desc.dstReceiver` uses definition `beneficiary` (addressName, no senderAddress).
findings.fix: Add `"params": {"senderAddress": "$.metadata.constants.addressAsNull"}` to the Beneficiary field.

findings.title: swap hides srcReceiver and the executor that receive the signer's input tokens.
findings.evidence: swap: `srcToken.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, desc.srcReceiver, desc.amount);` and the call to `caller` with `data`. Descriptor: `caller`, `desc.srcReceiver`, `data` visible never. The router balance check bounds the output.

findings.title: swap intent 'Swap' names no assets, amounts or recipient.
findings.evidence: Descriptor swap: `"intent": "Swap"`, no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent 'Swap {desc.amount} for at least {desc.minReturnAmount} to {desc.dstReceiver}'.

formats.key: unoswap(address srcToken, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, bytes32[] pools)
effects: The signer sends `amount` of srcToken to the first pair (transferFrom), or `amount` of ETH (msg.value == amount, wrapped to WETH) when srcToken is 0x0.
msg.value must be 0 for an ERC-20 source.
The signer receives the output of the last pair, an ERC-20 or ETH when the last pool has the WETH flag, at least minReturn (as computed from reserves).
formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send in srcToken, Minimum to Receive with no token, Beneficiary = signer, and the last pool word as an address.

findings.title: unoswap Minimum to Receive has no token; the output token comes from the last pool.
findings.evidence: UnoswapRouter.unoswap: the output token is the pair's other token, set by `_REVERSE_MASK`/`_WETH_MASK` bits in pools. Descriptor field `minReturn` has no tokenPath, so wallets show it raw as 'Unknown token'.

findings.title: unoswap shows the packed last pool word as an address, with flag and numerator bits.
findings.evidence: UnoswapRouter: `_REVERSE_MASK = 0x80..`, `_WETH_MASK = 0x40..`, `_NUMERATOR_MASK = 0x..ffffffff0000..`; pair = `and(rawPair, _ADDRESS_MASK)`. Descriptor field `pools.[-1]` addressName without slice.
findings.fix: Change the path to `pools.[-1].[12:32]`.

findings.title: unoswap intent 'Swap' names no assets or amounts.
findings.evidence: Descriptor unoswap: `"intent": "Swap"`.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent 'Swap {amount} for at least {minReturn}'.

formats.key: unoswapWithPermit(address srcToken, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, bytes32[] pools, bytes permit)
effects: The router submits a permit on srcToken in the signer's name, which sets an allowance.
The signer sends `amount` of srcToken to the first pair.
The signer receives the output of the last pair, at least minReturn.
formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send in srcToken, Minimum to Receive with no token, Beneficiary = signer, last pool word; permit hidden.

findings.title: unoswapWithPermit hides the permit that sets an allowance on srcToken.
findings.evidence: UnoswapRouter.unoswapWithPermit: `_permit(address(srcToken), permit);`. Descriptor: `permit` visible never.
findings.fix: Show the spender and value of the permit, or state 'Approves via permit' in the intent.

findings.title: unoswapWithPermit Minimum to Receive has no token; the output token comes from the pools.
findings.evidence: Descriptor field `minReturn` has no tokenPath; output token set by pool bits in UnoswapRouter.unoswap.

findings.title: unoswapWithPermit shows the packed last pool word as an address.
findings.evidence: Descriptor field `pools.[-1]` addressName; UnoswapRouter masks `_ADDRESS_MASK`, flags in high bits.
findings.fix: Change the path to `pools.[-1].[12:32]`.

formats.key: uniswapV3Swap(uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, uint256[] pools)
effects: The signer sends `amount` of the first pool's input token (transferFrom via callback), or `amount` ETH wrapped to WETH when pools[0] has the wrap flag.
msg.value equals amount with the wrap flag, else 0.
The signer receives the last pool's output token, or ETH with the unwrap flag, at least minReturn.
formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send and Minimum to Receive both without a token, Beneficiary = signer, and the last pool word.

findings.title: uniswapV3Swap shows both amounts without a token; tokens come from the pools.
findings.evidence: UnoswapV3Router.uniswapV3SwapCallback reads `token0`/`token1` from the pool; descriptor fields `amount` and `minReturn` have no tokenPath.

findings.title: uniswapV3Swap shows the last pool uint256 with direction and unwrap bits as an address.
findings.evidence: UnoswapV3Router: `_ONE_FOR_ZERO_MASK = 1 << 255`, `_WETH_UNWRAP_MASK = 1 << 253`. Descriptor field `pools.[-1]` addressName.
findings.fix: Change the path to `pools.[-1].[12:32]`.

findings.title: uniswapV3Swap intent 'Swap' names no assets or amounts.
findings.evidence: Descriptor: `"intent": "Swap"`.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent 'Swap {amount} for at least {minReturn}'.

formats.key: uniswapV3SwapTo(address recipient, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, uint256[] pools)
effects: The signer sends `amount` of the first pool's input token, or `amount` ETH when pools[0] has the wrap flag.
msg.value equals amount with the wrap flag, else 0.
The recipient receives the last pool's output token, or ETH with the unwrap flag, at least minReturn.
formats.shown: "Swap" with token-less Amount to Send and Minimum to Receive, Beneficiary = recipient, last pool word.

findings.title: uniswapV3SwapTo shows both amounts without a token; tokens come from the pools.
findings.evidence: Descriptor fields `amount`, `minReturn` have no tokenPath; tokens read in uniswapV3SwapCallback from the pool.

findings.title: uniswapV3SwapTo shows the last pool uint256 with flag bits as an address.
findings.evidence: Descriptor field `pools.[-1]` addressName; `_ONE_FOR_ZERO_MASK = 1 << 255`, `_WETH_UNWRAP_MASK = 1 << 253`.
findings.fix: Change the path to `pools.[-1].[12:32]`.

findings.title: uniswapV3SwapTo intent 'Swap' does not say the output goes to another address.
findings.evidence: Descriptor: `"intent": "Swap"`; field `recipient` labeled 'Beneficiary'.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent 'Swap {amount} for at least {minReturn} to {recipient}'.

formats.key: uniswapV3SwapToWithPermit(address recipient, address srcToken, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, uint256[] pools, bytes permit)
effects: The router submits a permit on srcToken in the signer's name.
The signer sends `amount` of the first pool's input token, which the code does not check against srcToken.
The recipient receives the last pool's output token, or ETH with the unwrap flag, at least minReturn.
formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send in srcToken, token-less Minimum to Receive, Beneficiary = recipient, last pool word; permit hidden.

findings.title: uniswapV3SwapToWithPermit names the sent token from srcToken, but the pool decides which token leaves.
findings.evidence: UnoswapV3Router.uniswapV3SwapToWithPermit: srcToken is used only in `_permit(address(srcToken), permit);` then `uniswapV3SwapTo(recipient, amount, minReturn, pools)`; the callback pulls `token0`/`token1` of the pool via `safeTransferFrom(payer, ...)`. Descriptor field `amount` has `"tokenPath": "srcToken"`.
findings.fix: Remove tokenPath srcToken from `amount` (show it as unknown token, like uniswapV3SwapTo), or label it 'Token permitted' as a separate field.

findings.title: uniswapV3SwapToWithPermit hides the permit that sets an allowance on srcToken.
findings.evidence: `_permit(address(srcToken), permit);`; descriptor `permit` visible never.
findings.fix: Show the spender and value of the permit.

findings.title: uniswapV3SwapToWithPermit shows the last pool uint256 with flag bits as an address.
findings.evidence: Descriptor field `pools.[-1]` addressName; flags at bits 255 and 253.
findings.fix: Change the path to `pools.[-1].[12:32]`.

findings.title: uniswapV3SwapToWithPermit Minimum to Receive has no token; the output token comes from the pools.
findings.evidence: Descriptor field `minReturn` has no tokenPath.

formats.key: clipperSwap(address srcToken, address dstToken, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn)
effects: The signer sends `amount` of srcToken to the Clipper pool, or WETH which the router unwraps, or `amount` ETH when srcToken is 0x0 (msg.value == amount).
msg.value is 0 for a token source.
The signer receives dstToken (ETH when 0x0, WETH when WETH), at least minReturn as enforced by the Clipper exchange.
formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send in srcToken, Minimum to Receive in dstToken, Beneficiary = signer.

findings.title: clipperSwap intent 'Swap' names no assets or amounts.
findings.evidence: Descriptor: `"intent": "Swap"`.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent 'Swap {amount} for at least {minReturn}'.

formats.key: clipperSwapTo(address recipient, address srcToken, address dstToken, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn)
effects: The signer sends `amount` of srcToken, WETH or ETH (msg.value == amount when srcToken is 0x0).
msg.value is 0 for a token source.
The recipient receives dstToken, at least minReturn as enforced by the Clipper exchange.
formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send in srcToken, Minimum to Receive in dstToken, Beneficiary = recipient.

findings.title: clipperSwapTo intent 'Swap' does not say the output goes to another address.
findings.evidence: Descriptor: `"intent": "Swap"`.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent 'Swap {amount} for at least {minReturn} to {recipient}'.

formats.key: clipperSwapToWithPermit(address recipient, address srcToken, address dstToken, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, bytes permit)
effects: The router submits a permit on srcToken in the signer's name.
The signer sends `amount` of srcToken (or WETH, unwrapped) to the Clipper pool.
The recipient receives dstToken, at least minReturn as enforced by the Clipper exchange.
formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send in srcToken, Minimum to Receive in dstToken, Beneficiary = recipient; permit hidden.

findings.title: clipperSwapToWithPermit hides the permit that sets an allowance on srcToken.
findings.evidence: ClipperRouter.clipperSwapToWithPermit: `_permit(address(srcToken), permit);`; descriptor `permit` visible never.
findings.fix: Show the spender and value of the permit.

findings.title: clipperSwapToWithPermit intent 'Swap' names no assets, amounts or recipient.
findings.evidence: Descriptor: `"intent": "Swap"`.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent 'Swap {amount} for at least {minReturn} to {recipient}'.

couldNotCheck: Clipper exchange 0x2e9c6Dcdca22A5952A88C4b18EDB5B54C5155BC9 (constructor arg of AggregationRouterV4) is not in the directory. clipperSwap, clipperSwapTo and clipperSwapToWithPermit rely on its sellTokenForToken/sellEthForToken/sellTokenForEth to enforce minReturn and pay the recipient; the router does not check returnAmount itself.
